highlights: Built GenAI Lab, a micro frontend platform in React.js. Each AI service (RAG, multimodal AI, report generator) runs as its own frontend with its own Python backend, with role-based access and ArgoCD deployments.

Built real-time pod and cluster monitoring dashboards in Vue.js for the Digital Human project using polling and server-sent event streams, showing live metrics, resource usage, and logs across all running services.

Designed the Vue.js dashboard displaying pod and cluster metrics and resource usage across the platform, and also contributed to the UE5 avatar work supporting the voice-driven 3D character used throughout the entire project.
Designed and shipped 20+ REST APIs using FastAPI with response times under 200ms, and wrote unit and integration tests using pytest, unittest, and Jest to keep the codebase stable across releases.

Worked with AWS S3 for file storage, EC2 and Lambda for compute and event-based processing, and implemented role-based access control using Keycloak with OAuth 2.0 and OIDC across a FastAPI and React.js stack.
